ody.text: Kirtar is an Order lieutenant whose strengths, as Pianna assesses them, are pride, devotion and ambition, and he competes in the Cabal's largest pit-fight tournament hoping to win an artifact for the Order to destroy.
When a Krosan dragon attacks the city Kirtar leads the defense, but Kamahl kills the dragon and Kirtar receives the reward, which is the Mirari.
Kirtar claims the Mirari to destroy it, but it corrupts him, and when Pianna demands the sphere he plots a coup and uses it to kill her.
His uncontrolled spell devastates the citadel and kills him, and Turg takes the artifact.

jud.text: Kirtar receives the Mirari and is overcome by the power it offers him, and he and his men repel beast attacks on the northern plains and then attack the forest of Krosa itself.
Pianna orders Kirtar and his men to withdraw, then asks him to destroy the Mirari, but he refuses and plots a coup.

Kirtar demands command of the Order and uses the Mirari to engulf Pianna in crystals, but the spell spreads out of control, Turg steals the Mirari, and Kirtar fades to nothing as the spell drains his essence.
